New service

Hand Embroidery

Add hand-worked detail to a blouse, lehenga, kurti, gown or dupatta. Discuss motifs, thread colours, zari, beadwork and placement with the boutique, then choose how much of the garment carries the work.

Bring a reference image or an old garment you want to refresh. Availability, pricing and timelines are confirmed by the boutique after your enquiry.

How it works

  1. Share your design idea.
  2. Discuss your preferences and requirements.
  3. Confirm the design and tailoring details with the boutique.
  4. Coordinate fitting, completion and collection directly with the boutique.

Crafting Style Around You

At Arora Designers, we believe every special occasion deserves an outfit that reflects your personality. From customized designer blouses to bridal outfits, kurtis, lehengas, frocks, hand embroidery and saree pre-pleating, we help customers explore designs that suit their preferences and celebrations.

Arora Designers is run by Monika in Karur, Tamil Nadu. Follow recent work on Instagram @arora_designers.
